title: New Polish Libre 2 14 day Sensor 7F 0E 30
symptom: xDrip does not properly recognize the latest Libre 2 sensors in Poland with serial numbers starting with 301, treating them as Libre 1 fallback. NFC scanning gives 'Incorrect NFC data' and logs show 0x7f0e30.
cause: xDrip does not recognize the new sensor type (0x7f0e30) and treats it as Libre 1 fallback.
fix: A test release (based on PR #4180) with an updated OOP2 and enabling a setting (switched off by default) in the test version resolved the issue. The sensor is recognized as Libre2Plus and readings work. The fix was included in the 2025.09.26 release.
evidence_quote: As of the 2025.09.26 release, this sensor is recognized.
